![The beetle](https://www.flickr.com/photo_download.gne?id=53265526303&secret=d41e1a61fd&size=s&source=photoPageEngagement){#fig-beetle}


We are working on the Sonoran desert bark beetle (@fig-beetle). 


## Vectors

Some examples of containers.

```{r}

myNumbers <- c( 23, 4354, 45, 12, 56)
myNumbers


myNumbers[3] <- 3.2
myNumbers


myFam <- c( "Gary", "Joannie", "Rodney", "Heather", "Sid", "Heidi", "Mark", "Marie", "Robin", "Joshua" )

myFam
rev( myFam )
sort( myFam )

myFam[ c(2,1, 5, 3, 2) ]
myFam[ c( TRUE, FALSE, TRUE ) ]


length( myFam )
nchar( myFam )

```


## List

Things that we do with lists


```{r}

dyers <- list( FirstNames = myFam ) 



dyers$FirstNames[ 4 ]

dyers$numMales <- 5 
dyers$NumFemales <- 5 

dyers


names( dyers )
length( dyers )

```

My family had `r dyers$numMales` boys and `r dyers$NumFemales` girls in it.

## Data Frames




These are `data.frames` and are like spreadsheets and here is the @fig-beetle one.

```{r}

library( tidyverse )

url <- "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/DyerlabTeaching/Data-Containers/main/data/arapat.csv"

read_csv( url ) -> df 

summary( df )

plot( df$Longitude, df$Latitude )

nrow( df )
ncol( df )

dim( df )



```
